title: How Praying to Become Him Changes More Than Praying to Meet Her
caption:
A godly man stops praying for a wife and starts praying to become one worth choosing. The order decides whether he's waiting or working.

Start the list with your own sin, not her arrival. Get busy enough becoming him that you stop performing for anyone. Let the Word set the bar, not the group chat: Proverbs 31 was written for men worth marrying too, not just women worth marrying.

The wait isn't God being slow. It's God building the man who won't waste what he sends. Pray to become him. Let the finding take care of itself.

theme: He chases God, not a wife.
